extracted.intended_audience: members of the news media / journalists seeking information from Habitat for Humanity
extracted.subtask_description: Guidance and organizational information for press releases and media relations from a nonprofit (Habitat for Humanity) newsroom, covering what the newsroom publishes, available media resources, contacts, and topical expertise for interviews. Useful for producing or distributing press materials about the organization's corporate news, partnerships, events, and programs.

rubrics_metrics.name: Coverage — latest press releases covering corporate news
rubrics_metrics.description: Habitat for Humanity’s newsroom has the latest press releases covering Habitat’s corporate news.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The newsroom is positioned as the authoritative source for recent corporate announcements; individual entries are presented with headline and date and link to 'Read more' for full release.

rubrics_metrics.name: Availability of subject-matter experts
rubrics_metrics.description: Habitat for Humanity has experts available to the media on a wide array of topics, including affordable housing, residential home construction and repairs, neighborhood revitalization, community development, volunteerism, philanthropy and nonprofit fundraising, disaster recovery, international development, housing microfinance, among others.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Press materials and interview requests should identify topical needs; the organization can provide experts across these listed topic areas for quotes or interviews.

rubrics_metrics.name: Provision of interviews and additional resources (media requests)
rubrics_metrics.description: Members of the news media may request interviews or additional resources — including high-resolution photographs and video footage — by contacting the media and public affairs team at [email protected].
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Press releases / newsroom listings should make clear how to request interviews and assets by providing a media contact email; the page explicitly offers interviews and additional media resources upon request.

rubrics_metrics.name: High-quality photography and video assets available
rubrics_metrics.description: We can offer the news media high-quality Habitat photography and video as well as quotes and interviews about our work.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Press materials should note availability of high-resolution photographs and video footage for media use and how to obtain them (via the Media Relations contact).

rubrics_metrics.name: Media contact information and distribution (sign-up)
rubrics_metrics.description: Sign up to receive emails with Habitat’s latest press releases. Contact our Media Relations team at [email protected]. For all non-media related inquiries, call 1-800-HABITAT – (800) 422-4828.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The newsroom provides explicit channels for distribution (email sign-up) and direct contact; press releases should include clear contact details and options to subscribe for updates.

rubrics_metrics.name: Press release content types / topical examples
rubrics_metrics.description: Examples of newsroom items include: corporate partnerships and donations (e.g., Nissan Americas donation), grant announcements (Wells Fargo Foundation awards), program expansions (Henkel partnership), volunteer build events (Jimmy & Rosalynn Carter Work Project), calls to action (urging G7 to prioritize housing), obituaries/official statements (mourning Jimmy Carter), appointments (chief financial officer hire), annual report/impact summaries.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The newsroom demonstrates the acceptable/typical subjects for press releases — partnerships, grants, program updates, events, advocacy statements, leadership announcements and impact reports — which can serve as a content taxonomy when producing releases.

rubrics_metrics.name: Regional edition / geographic focus
rubrics_metrics.description: This page is about our work in the North America region. Make North America your preferred site edition.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Press releases and newsroom content are organized by region; releases intended for specific audiences should indicate regional relevance and ensure they appear under the correct site edition.
